facts.fact: The Central Bank of Nigeria issued a circular ordering all banks, payment service providers, mobile money operators and fintechs to store and manage all domestic payment transaction data inside Nigeria by 1 January 2027, covering ledgers, audit logs, disaster-recovery backups and encryption keys.

facts.fact: The Nigeria Data Protection Commission is led by National Commissioner and CEO Dr Vincent Olatunji and acts as the data protection regulator.

The Nigeria Data Protection Commission issued a 58-page Final Order with a USD 32.8 million remedial fine and enforcement orders against Meta over consent, minors' data and cross-border transfers; the fine was dropped in a consent judgment on 3 November 2025.
The Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 is in force; its section 49 makes non-compliance with Commission orders an offence punishable by a fine or up to a year in prison.
The Nigeria Data Protection Commission, led by National Commissioner Dr Vincent Olatunji, enforces the Act.
